description: Trigger when the customer reports a damaged or defective item and requests a refund or replacement.

steps.title: Step 1: Collect Order ID & Damage Details
steps.prompt: I'm so sorry your item arrived damaged. Could you share your Order ID and let me know which item was affected?

variables.name: damage_reason
variables.description: Short description of the item damage.

steps.title: Step 2: Lookup Order & Check Return Window

outputVariableMappings.name: return_window_status
outputVariableMappings.description: Whether the order is within the 30-day return window.

steps.title: Step 4: Explain Expired Return Window & Store Credit Option
steps.prompt: Because this order is past our 30-day return window, I cannot issue a card refund automatically, but I can offer a merchandise store credit.

steps.title: Step 5: Share Refund Confirmation Code
steps.prompt: Your refund has been processed and you will receive an email confirmation shortly.
